title: Chapter 154 The Second Big Explosion
content:
Chapter 154 The Second Big Explosion

There were less than a thousand bear goblins, facing a 100,000-strong Zerg army, and they rushed to the center of the Zerg army with unstoppable force. This shows how powerful this cavalry is!

The long-range weapons of the bear goblins, the metal chain hammers, were exhausted, and they lost their super-destructive means of area killing, which allowed the Zerg puppies to successfully encircle them.

They faced all-round attacks from the front, back, left, right, and air of the Zerg puppies, and even had to face the attacks of the Zerg puppies that drilled out directly from their feet, which slowed down their charge and eventually had to stop!

The encircled Zerg puppies killed into the ranks of the bear goblins through frontal impact, air jumps, and underground attacks!

The bear goblins, who consumed less energy at the rear of the evil god's army, swung their maces into a ball of silver flowers, and flew away the Zerg puppies that rushed from all directions!

The Zerg puppies attacked in groups. If ten were not enough, they would be one hundred, and if one hundred were not enough, they would be one thousand!

Using the surrounding buildings, Zerg puppies pounced on the Goblin Dragoons from the air in groups!

The Zerg puppies that were knocked down into the enemy's formation would bite the enemy as long as they did not die immediately!

In this way, the Zerg puppies continued to consume the enemy with their lives!

The Zerg one-star Hydralisk completely lost its shooting range, and they stopped attacking. The arduous task of destroying the evil god's army could only be completed by the Zerg puppies alone!

Wu Qing ordered the useless one-star Hydralisk to retreat. The evil god's means of sacrifice were hard to defend against, and he did not want to lose these one-star Hydralisks that consumed a lot of gas resources to upgrade.

More and more Zerg puppies pounced into the team of the Goblin Dragoons. Before they consumed the evil god's state blessing, they were all sending themselves to death!

The combat power of these Goblin Dragoons was too strong. Nearly a thousand cavalrymen stopped in the Zerg army, like an extremely hard iron rod, no matter how they were hit or hammered, they were motionless!

According to the Queen's statistics, the Zerg lost nearly 100,000 puppies in the battle with the nearly 1,000 cavalry!

Looking at this situation, if the Zerg puppies continue to be sent up, those bear goblins and dragon cavalry and evil god priests can continue to kill!

"Should I make another move?"

The Queen said to Wu Qing.

"Not for now, you are our last trump card in this world, and you need to maintain the strongest combat power at all times."

"If you make another move, it will take some time to recover."

Wu Qing disagreed with the Queen's move at this time.

If the Queen doesn't make a move, it's fine. If she makes a move, it's a big move. If she uses too little force, it will be a pure waste if it doesn't work. So she would rather consume a little more power to solve the problem at one time.

These nearly 1,000 evil god troops can survive the attack of the Queen because they are protected by the evil god whose strength exceeds the limit of this world. It's not surprising that the Queen can't beat them without trying her best.

If she does it again, the Queen is sure to solve them with one blow.

But the mental power consumed by the Queen of Zerg needs time to recover. If the Zerg encounters an irresistible enemy during this period, and the Queen of Zerg is not in full strength, the risk is great!

Wu Qing dare not bet in this world whether the system has a backup plan to help him escape in times of crisis!

The power that you can control is the most reliable.

The Zerg has consumed nearly 10,000 Zerg puppies. Those bear goblins who have persisted to this day in the ultra-high-intensity battle seem to be able to fight for hundreds of rounds!

In order to be on the safe side, Wu Qing dispatched another batch of Zerg puppies into the city.

…

The battle continued, and Wu Qing, who had been observing the battlefield situation, suddenly had a heart attack!

"Not good!"

Wu Qing's ability to perceive danger is very strong, and he immediately noticed that there was a terrible change on the battlefield!

The Queen of Zerg is a strengthened version of Wu Qing's ability. It also noticed the abnormality on the battlefield. Without thinking, the powerful mental power instantly descended on the Zerg one-star host on standby around the battlefield!

"Boom!"

Another terrifying explosion!

With the positions of the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry and the evil god priest as the center, the explosion swept everything around!

Along with countless Zerg puppies fighting fiercely, they were blown away without a trace!

This was an emergency. In order to be on the safe side, the Queen of the Worm attacked without reservation. This explosion was not much less powerful than the first explosion.

"The evil god priest should have communicated with a terrifying existence!"

Without the Queen of the Worm's explanation, Wu Qing also understood the danger at that moment.

The powerful evil god priest, at some unknown price, attracted another terrifying existence!

With Wu Qing's crisis perception ability, such a strong danger warning was generated. The existence that the evil god priest wanted to attract must be able to attack directly in this world!

The consequences of this are unimaginable!

Faced with this crisis, the Queen of the Worm, who can be regarded as Wu Qing's alternative clone, didn't think much, but used a big move to destroy the entire area where the evil god priest was!

This successfully interrupted the inexplicable summoning and prevented an unpredictable crisis!

In the end, the Queen of Zerg took action again!

These evil god priests repeatedly used magic and secret methods far beyond their own strength in the battle with the Zerg. Wu Qing didn't know whether this was specifically aimed at the Zerg, or whether the priests in this world were just so powerful.

"Wu Cong, as far as you know, under what circumstances can the evil god priests use abilities far beyond their own strength?"

Wu Qing asked Wu Cong, who had been silent beside him.

"They have the artifacts containing the power of the evil god, or have obtained the special blessing of the evil god, so they can rely on the power of the evil god to exert abilities far beyond their own strength!"

"But this situation is very rare, the power of the evil god cannot easily come to this world!"

Wu Cong explained to Wu Qing.

Wu Cong and the soldiers of the Daxia army have experienced many wars and witnessed many big scenes.

But this kind of battle with the invincible army blessed by the evil god himself is the first time they have seen it, not to mention the big explosion created by the queen of insects. Without the protection of the evil god's power, everything will be blown to ashes!

This makes them have a further personal experience of the strength of the Zerg!

"Then the abilities of these priests are the means of the evil god against the Zerg!"

"That's good!"

Wu Qing knew that the Zerg had received the attention of the evil god, and it was not surprising to use various means against the Zerg, as long as such means came at a price.

The enemy has paid a price, and the system has gained something.

…

The explosion on the battlefield ended, and a huge area of building ruins appeared in a circular shape on the battlefield.

The one-star hosts of the Zerg were all injured to varying degrees, and they were flying away from the battlefield and flying towards the Zerg territory.

Only a few Zerg puppies survived on the ruins, and the wounded Zerg puppies were still struggling to get up and prepare to continue fighting!

A large number of Zerg puppies that besieged the Bugbear Dragoons disappeared. The Queen's attack alone caused the loss of more than 50,000 Zerg puppies!

These lost Zerg puppies were only affected by the explosion. The center position that really bore the full power of the Queen's attack had become a deep pit, with only exposed soil and rocks left.

This explosion had no smell of fireworks, and the deep pit was filled with the smell of fresh soil, and even underground spring water could be seen gushing out.

The invincible figures of the bear goblins and the evil god priests who were fighting at this location have disappeared without a trace, including the evil god priest!

After many twists and turns, the siege launched by the Zerg finally ended.

The Zerg puppies were not affected by the huge losses. Those who could move normally began to disperse into various parts of the city, carefully exploring every corner of the city, eliminating dangerous hidden dangers, and collecting information.

The alliance army outside the city experienced the impact of two consecutive horrific explosions. They were all very glad that they did not fight in the city. Such a battlefield was not something they could participate in at all.

They witnessed the power of the Zerg with their own eyes, and they were more respectful. They were also full of gratitude in their hearts. They were grateful to Wu Qing and the Zerg for not letting them go on the field as cannon fodder.

Especially those alliance lords and armies who participated in the war. If Wu Qing had not ordered them to retreat, they would definitely not be able to come back!

Although the Alliance troops outside the city could not see the battle in the city, they could see how fierce the battle in the city was from the Zerg troops that kept pouring into the city and the devastating explosion!

The emotional changes of the more than 200,000 lords and soldiers from the various territories of the Alliance outside the city could provide continuous gas resources for the system.

When they returned to the territory and conveyed this emotion to others, they would influence more people to continue to provide gas resources for the system.

This is the value of their participation in the war. If they could not provide help on the battlefield, they would make up for it in other places!

After the entire city was explored by Zerg puppies and Zerg hosts, the Alliance army received an order to enter the city, count the supplies, clean up the ruins, and temporarily garrison the city.

The city was affected by the battle and severely damaged, but both sides avoided the storage of supplies in the city. Neither side of the battle thought that they would lose, and neither side wanted to destroy the large amount of supplies stored in the city that were enough for hundreds of thousands of troops to garrison for a long time.

Now that the Zerg has won, these supplies have become the Zerg's spoils of war.

The Alliance army has been holding back a lot of energy, but now they have nowhere to use it, so it's just right to use it up, give them something to do, and vent their emotions.

Let them experience the atmosphere of the battlefield in person. Although there are no corpses on the battlefield, the degree of its tragic nature can still be seen through the battlefield environment.

A large number of Zerg combat arms continue to gather here. Zerg puppies and hosts expand the reconnaissance range of the east side of the city to monitor the movements of the evil god camp.

In the entire Alliance territory, Zerg puppies are dispatched more intensively, scouting everywhere and collecting intelligence.

The two big explosions just caused by the Queen of Zerg may attract the attention of those who are interested. Wu Qing needs to fully grasp the relevant situation.

The lord's scepter of the city has also been found. Like the Alliance City, the cities occupied by the evil god camp have undergone special transformations. Without the lord and the people, the long-term existence of this territory can be maintained.
